scope: Piano-roll UI-to-audio journey and voice cleanup on every termination path
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform, silent preview clock
verified_behaviors: QML-built clip: converted notes deleted by Shift-click and Delete, square wave chosen, three notes typed, one dragged a sixteenth later
Float export: note A sounds from frame 30000 to 41999 at 0.25*0.09; B and C overlap from 48000 at the summed level, C ends at 60000, B at 72000; zero-crossing counts match 440 Hz and 220 Hz within 2
Undo moves A's onset to frame 24000, Redo restores 30000; Save and reopening in a fresh window export sample-identical audio

Voices reach zero after Silence now; after deleting every note while playing (and stay zero for 2.5 s); after a shorter loop's cut notes end; after Loop off ends the clip and stops the track; and after Stop
RenderStatus publishes the engine's active voice count with each render acknowledgement
limits: Rendered export and preview-clock acknowledgements, not a PipeWire capture; offscreen platform; no physical audio.
